name: amount-stepper
title: Amount Stepper
description: Minus, amount and plus in one inline control: decimal steps, min and max, and a ticker label for token amounts.

props.name: step
props.description: Size of one step. Decimals are fine (0.01, 0.5).

props.name: unit
props.description: Ticker or currency shown after the amount, e.g. 'ETH'.

props.name: decimals
props.description: Fraction digits shown. Defaults to the digits of step.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new clamped amount.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
